svg.title: fit — condition the selected model on an observation panel
svg.desc: A model the particle engine cannot fit, observations it cannot use, or non-finite draws fail the call. Otherwise Pathfinder initializes particle Gibbs on the exact nonlinear target, diagnostics are recorded, and the conditioned model commits as a new revision with its inference and check reports.

g.text: the model is incomplete, or its laws cannot be fitted
initialization or draws are not finite
Particle Gibbs on the exact nonlinear target
R-hat · bulk and tail ESS · MCSE · acceptance
one joint law over parameters and latent paths
